title: ADAB: Arabic Dataset for Automated Politeness Benchmarking - A Large-Scale Resource for Computational Sociopragmatics

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative error pattern analysis across polarity transitions (confusion matrix analysis), measuring the percentage of explicit polite and impolite utterances that are disproportionately misclassified as neutral by the models.

Qualitative error analysis of model misclassifications, specifically examining how models fail to accurately interpret regional Arabic dialects (e.g., Egyptian and Maghrebi varieties) and cultural idioms compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) or Gulf Arabic.
